title: Reinsure
summary: REINSU'RE, verb transitive [re and insure.] To insure the same property a second time by other underwriters. The insurer may cause the property insured to be reinsured by other persons.

inlines.v: REINSU'RE, verb transitive [re and insure.] To insure the same property a second time by other underwriters. The insurer may cause the property insured to be reinsured by other persons.
